name: U.S. facilitator/laptop-farm enforcement scale through FY 2026

attribution.legal_posture: Official U.S. government aggregate or risk-assessment finding. Underlying pending case summaries remain allegations where applicable

caveats: The 10-person, approximately $25 million, and approximately 525-laptop figures aggregate multiple investigations and overlap individual case totals.
The publication date uses the DOJ landing page's Updated May 29, 2026 date; the linked PDF's separate issue-date field is absent.
This is a DOJ budget/performance narrative rather than a charging instrument or adjudicated finding.

statements: DOJ states that from May 2024 through FY 2025, National Security Cyber charged 10 U.S.-based individuals who helped DPRK IT-worker teams generate approximately $25 million in income.
DOJ states that approximately 525 employer-provided laptops were seized in these and other DPRK IT-worker investigations from U.S.-based facilitator residences.
The document says DPRK IT-worker teams can generate as much as $3 million annually.
